metadata.description: contexture's plugins for Claude: the skills for working in any contexture store through its connector, and a small plugin for a second opinion on its own.

plugins.name: contexture
plugins.description: contexture's skills for working in a contexture store from Claude: capture, file into notes, find connections, keep rollups and the mission current, and submit a change for approval. Add your store's connector separately.

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: A second opinion from three AI models of different families: a critique of a written plan, or a poll on one question. One skill, no store needed. Add a second-opinion connector separately. Install it only without the contexture plugin.
